description_zh: 寻找前往某个位置的路线并绕过途径的障碍物。
description_en: Find paths around obstacles, and optionally move along them.

conditions.description_zh: 执行在寻路动作后，成功找到寻路路线时触发。
conditions.description_en: Triggered after 'Find path' when a path successfully found.

conditions.description_zh: 执行在寻路动作后，无法找到寻路路线时触发。
conditions.description_en: Triggered after 'Find path' when no path could be found.

conditions.name_zh: 检查单元格位置存在障碍物
conditions.description_zh: 检测指定的单元格坐标位置是否存在障碍物。
conditions.description_en: Test if a cell in the pathfinding map is marked as an obstacle.
conditions.display_zh: {my}寻路单元格({0}, {1}) 存在障碍物

params.desc_en: The horizontal cell to test if an obstacle (in cells, rather than layout co-ordinates).
params.desc_zh: 要检测的寻路单元格X，基于 0 开始计数。

params.desc_en: The vertical cell to test if an obstacle (in cells, rather than layout co-ordinates).
params.desc_zh: 要检测的寻路单元格Y，基于 0 开始计数。

conditions.description_zh: 检测对象当前是否正在寻找路线。
conditions.description_en: True if the object is currently searching for a path.

conditions.description_zh: 检测对象是否正沿着一条已找到的路线移动。
conditions.description_en: True if the object is currently moving along a found path.

conditions.description_zh: 当沿着路线移动并抵达目的时触发
conditions.description_en: Triggered when moving along path and arrived at destination.

conditions.description_zh: 以当前对象的移动速度进行对比
conditions.description_en: Compare the current movement speed of the object.

params.desc_en: How to compare the current movement speed.
params.desc_zh: 选择一种比较方式。

params.desc_en: The speed to compare to, in pixels per second.
params.desc_zh: 进行速度对比的对象，以像素/秒为单位

conditions.description_zh: 检测是否允许跨越单元格进行斜向对角移动。
conditions.description_en: True if diagonal movement across cells is currently enabled.

conditions.description_zh: 检测当前行为是否已启用。
conditions.description_en: Test if the behavior is enabled.

actions.description_zh: 开始寻找前往目的地的路线，完成后将会触发 '找到路线' 或 '寻找路线失败'。
actions.description_en: Start looking for a path to a destination, later triggering 'On path found' or 'On failed to find path'.

params.desc_en: The X co-ordinate to find a path to.
params.desc_zh: 要寻找路线的位置 X 坐标。

params.desc_en: The Y co-ordinate to find a path to.
params.desc_zh: 要寻找路线的位置 Y 坐标。

actions.description_zh: 启用或禁用此行为。
actions.description_en: Enable or disable the behavior.

params.desc_en: Whether to enable or disable the behavior.
params.desc_zh: 启用或禁用此行为。

actions.description_zh: 重新检查场景内的每个单元格，检测障碍物是否存在，防止障碍物的位置已经改变。注意，此动作需要一定时间，在下一帧触发完成条件。
actions.description_en: (Slow) Check every cell to determine if it is an obstacle again, in case obstacles have moved or changed. Completes next tick.

actions.description_zh: 使用自定义障碍物时，添加一个家族对象或特定对象作为目标。
actions.description_en: When using custom obstacles, add a family or object as an obstacle.

params.desc_en: Choose a family or object to use as obstacles in the pathfinding map.
params.desc_zh: 在寻路图中选择一个家族对象或特定对象作为障碍物。

actions.description_zh: 清除所有添加的自定义障碍物。
actions.description_en: Clear the added custom obstacles.
actions.display_zh: {my} 清除所有自定义障碍物

actions.description_zh: 设置移动到相邻单元格的基本成本，这会影响其他成本的相对效果。
actions.description_en: Set the basic cost for moving to an adjacent cell, which affects the relative effect of other costs.

params.desc_en: The basic cost to move to an adjacent cell while calculating a path.
params.desc_zh: 移动到相邻单元格的基本成本。

actions.description_zh: 增加对象在前进路径的成本，用于模拟不同的地形的难易度。
actions.description_en: Increase the path cost for travelling over an object (e.g. to simulate rough terrain).
actions.display_zh: 增加 {my} 经过对象 {0} 的寻路成本 [i]{1}[/i]

params.desc_en: Choose an object to increase pathfinding cost.
params.desc_zh: 选择一个对象，增加寻路路线经过的成本。

params.desc_en: The additional cost to travel over this object. Note normal costs are 10 and 14 for horizontal/diagonal movement respectively.
params.desc_zh: 增加此物体在寻路计算时的额外成本。注意，默认情况下，水平/对角线运动的成本分别为 10 和14。

actions.description_zh: 清除当前添加的所有额外寻路成本
actions.description_en: Clear any additional path cost that was previously added.
actions.display_zh: 清除 {my} 的额外寻路成本

actions.description_zh: 从场景坐标中的矩形区域重新生成障碍物地图。下次运行事件时完成(即下一帧)。
actions.description_en: Regenerate just a rectangular portion of the obstacle map in layout co-ordinates. Completes next tick.

params.desc_en: Start X co-ordinate in layout of rectangle to regenerate.
params.desc_zh: 在矩形场景中重新生成的起始X坐标

params.desc_en: Start Y co-ordinate in layout of rectangle to regenerate.
params.desc_zh: 在矩形场景中重新生成的起始Y坐标

params.desc_en: End X co-ordinate in layout of rectangle to regenerate.
params.desc_zh: 在矩形场景中重新生成的结束X坐标

params.desc_en: End Y co-ordinate in layout of rectangle to regenerate.
params.desc_zh: 在矩形场景中重新生成的结束Y坐标

actions.name_zh: 重新生成物体周围的区域
actions.description_zh: 从指定对象的边界框中重新生成障碍路线。此动作需要到下一个运行周期完成。
actions.description_en: Regenerate just a rectangular portion of the obstacle map from an object's bounding box. Completes next tick.
actions.display_zh: {my} 重新计算 {0} 周围的障碍路线

params.desc_en: An object whose bounding box will determine a rectangular portion of the obstacle map to regenerate.
params.desc_zh: 选择一个对象，使用该对象的碰撞边界框重新生成障碍图的矩形部分。

actions.description_zh: 对相同分组的寻路路径四周增加临时寻路成本来分散路径，防止它们采用完全相同的路径。
actions.description_en: Spread out paths by adding a temporary extra cost around found paths in the same group.
actions.display_zh: {my}: 开始路径组 (基础成本: [i]{0}[/i], 分散单元格: [i]{1}[/i], 最大线程数: [i]{2}[/i])
actions.display_en: {my}: Start path group (base cost [i]{0}[/i], cell spread [i]{1}[/i], max workers [i]{2}[/i])

params.desc_en: The extra cost to add around found paths, which is multiplied depending on the number of workers used.
params.desc_zh: 在寻路路径周围增加额外的寻路成本，该成本根据使用的线程数量成倍增加。

params.desc_en: The number of cells around the found path to increase cost for. Prefer to use an odd number.
params.desc_zh: 增加的额外寻路成本，最好使用奇数。

params.desc_en: The maximum number of worker threads to distribute paths across for this group. Each worker tracks costs separately.
params.desc_zh: 为此分组分配路径的最大线程数，每个线程单独跟踪寻路成本。

actions.description_zh: 结束一个路径组，恢复正常的寻路。
actions.description_en: End a path group, restoring normal pathfinding.

actions.description_zh: 在 '找到路线' 条件中使用。开始沿着一条找到的路线移动。
actions.description_en: Start moving along a found path after the 'On path found' trigger.

actions.description_zh: 停止沿着路线移动
actions.description_en: Stop moving along a path.

actions.description_zh: 设置移动时可达到的最大移动速度，以像素/秒为单位。
actions.description_en: Set the maximum speed for moving along paths.

params.desc_en: The maximum speed to set, in pixels per second.
params.desc_zh: 设置移动时可达到的最大移动速度，以像素/秒为单位。

actions.description_zh: 设置沿路径移动时的加速度。
actions.description_en: Set the acceleration for moving along paths.

params.desc_en: The acceleration to set, in pixels per second per second.
params.desc_zh: 从静止状态到正常移动速度的加速度，以像素/秒为单位。

actions.description_zh: 设置沿路径移动时的减速度。
actions.description_en: Set the deceleration for moving along paths.

params.desc_en: The deceleration to set, in pixels per second per second.
params.desc_zh: 从正常移动至完全停止的减速度，以像素/秒为单位。

actions.description_zh: 设置沿路径移动时的转向速度。
actions.description_en: Set the turn speed for moving along paths.
actions.display_en: Set {my} rotate speed to [i]{0}[/i] degrees per second

params.desc_en: The turn speed to set, in degrees per second.
params.desc_zh: 沿路线移动时的转向速度，以每秒度数为单位。

actions.description_zh: 启用或禁用穿过单元格时的对角线移动
actions.description_en: Enable or disable diagonal movement across cells.

params.desc_en: Whether to enable or disable diagonal movement across cells.
params.desc_zh: 是否启用或禁用穿过单元格时的对角线移动

actions.description_zh: 设置 '直接移动' 模式。当周围没有障碍物时，如何向下一个路径点移动。
actions.description_en: Set where to allow moving directly towards a node when the surrounding area is clear.

params.desc_en: Where to allow moving directly towards a node when the surrounding area is clear.
params.desc_zh: 当周围没有障碍物时，允许直接向下一个路径点移动。

actions.description_zh: 设置沿路径移动时的移动速度。
actions.description_en: Set the current speed for moving along paths.

params.desc_en: The speed to set, in pixels per second.
params.desc_zh: 设置的速度，以像素/秒为单位

expressions.description_zh: 沿着找到的路径途中的节点数。
expressions.description_en: The number of nodes along a found path.
The X co-ordinate of a node at an index.

params.desc_en: Zero-based index of node in path.
params.desc_zh: 路径节点的索引，从 0 开始计数。

expressions.description_en: The Y co-ordinate of a node at an index.

params.desc_en: Zero-based index of node in path.
params.desc_zh: 路径节点的索引，从 0 开始计数。

expressions.description_zh: 当前的移动角度，以角度/秒为单位。
expressions.description_en: The current angle of motion along a path, in degrees.

expressions.description_zh: 当前朝向的路径节点，从 0 开始计数。
expressions.description_en: The current zero-based node index moving towards.

expressions.description_zh: 当前的移动速度，以像素/秒为单位。
expressions.description_en: The current speed in pixels per second while moving.

expressions.description_zh: 当前最高速度，以像素/秒为单位
expressions.description_en: The current maximum speed in pixels per second.

expressions.description_zh: 从静止状态到正常移动速度的加速度，以像素/秒为单位。
expressions.description_en: The current acceleration in pixels per second per second.

expressions.description_zh: 从正常移动至完全停止的减速度，以像素/秒为单位。
expressions.description_en: The current deceleration in pixels per second per second.

expressions.description_zh: 当前最大转向速度，以角度/秒为单位。
expressions.description_en: The current maximum turn speed in degrees per second.

properties.description_en: The size of cells for pathfinding. Smaller sizes will use more CPU.
properties.description_zh: 路线使用的单元格大小。单元格越小寻路越精细，CPU负载也更大。

properties.description_en: Additional size to detect obstacles. Prevents paths very close to obstacles.
properties.description_zh: 用于侦测障碍物的额外尺寸，以防止行进路线过于贴近障碍物

properties.description_en: Use either solids or custom objects as obstacles.
properties.description_zh: 指定实体对象或自定义对象作为障碍物。

properties.description_en: For movement, the maximum speed in pixels per second.
properties.description_zh: 移动时可达到的最大移动速度，以像素/秒为单位。

properties.description_en: For movement, the acceleration in pixels per second per second.
properties.description_zh: 从静止状态到正常移动速度的加速度，以像素/秒为单位。

properties.description_en: For movement, the deceleration in pixels per second per second.
properties.description_zh: 从正常移动至完全停止的减速度，以像素/秒为单位。

properties.description_en: For movement, the maximum turn speed in degrees per second.
properties.description_zh: 移动时的转向速度,以度/秒为单位。

properties.description_en: For movement, whether to change the object's angle.
properties.description_zh: 移动中是否改变对象的角度

properties.description_en: Whether paths are allowed to use diagonal directions.
properties.description_zh: 是否允许路径使用对角线方向

properties.description_en: Where to allow moving directly towards a node when the surrounding area is clear.
properties.description_zh: 当周围没有障碍物时，允许直接向下一个节点移动。

properties.description_en: Whether the behavior is initially enabled or disabled.
properties.description_zh: 游戏初始化时，是否默认启用该行为。
